heading: Implementation of a sentence of fine
lead: The implementation of a sentence to pay a fine is governed by the provisions of subchapter B of chapter 229.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: For prior sections 3574 to 3580, applicable to offenses committed prior to Nov. 1, 1987, see note set out preceding section 3551 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Nov. 1, 1987, and applicable only to offenses committed after the taking effect of this section, see section 235(a)(1) of Pub. L. 98–473, set out as a note under section 3551 of this title.
